scope: Evidence for the next mounting-geometry revision. No mounting adapter is supplied or accepted by this record.

sources.inspected: PDF pages 34-35 / printed 28-29, rendered and visually inspected.
facts: The standard holder attaches to a separate sample-compartment baseplate using slotted screws.
The instrument supports exchanging Snap-In baseplates; a Smart baseplate also carries experiment identification.
The removable accessory support belongs to the slide-mounted holder and is retained when that slot is temporarily used for a sample or filter.
sources.limits: The illustrations are not dimension drawings or mounting instructions specific to the two angular accessories.

sources.inspected: Web-extracted PDF text, zero-based pages 16-17 / printed 13-14. No local PDF hash or visual-image review claimed.
facts: Specac 549-093 / GS49093 lists Nicolet 6700 and a right-to-left beam.
Its installation requires Thermo sample-compartment floor 714-006000 and two supplied 8-32 UNC cap-head screws.
The additional 714-006200 extension is specified for iS10/iS20, not automatically for 6700.
sources.limits: This establishes one commercial mounting scheme. It does not establish Harrick HRS or Spectra-Tech 500 compatibility, hole spacing or optical height.
sources.retrieval: Direct public PDF requests to both specac.com and www.specac.com returned HTTP 403. Web text was accessible; screenshot calls did not expose viewable images in this tool environment.

facts: Nicolet 6700 is listed among instruments supported by Benchmark-compatible Specac accessories.
sources.limits: A spectrometer compatibility listing does not extend to accessories from other manufacturers.

Check complete installed and insertion envelopes including mirrors, sample loading and the spectrometer cover.
Keep historical paper identity, sourced dimensions and authored hypotheses separate.
